results.question: Tell me about the AI assistant on his portfolio.
results.answer: Sreehari built a Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot that runs on his personal portfolio website. The assistant stores his resume and project notes in vector chunks, retrieves the most relevant pieces with an open‑source embedding model, and then uses a large language model to answer recruiter questions strictly from that retrieved context. It includes guardrails that refuse off‑topic queries, resist prompt‑injection attempts, and rate‑limit usage, all operating on free‑tier services. The live site can be visited at https://sreeharisuresh.vercel.app.

results.question: Tell me about his traffic signal project.
results.answer: Sreehari built an Intelligent Traffic Signal Control system that uses computer‑vision techniques to count vehicles in each lane from live video. The prototype employs YOLO and OpenCV with Python to detect vehicles, then dynamically adjusts the traffic‑signal timing to give priority to high‑volume lanes while still guaranteeing a minimum wait time for every lane. In controlled tests the system achieved 98 % vehicle‑detection accuracy.

results.question: How does his currency authentication project work?
results.answer: Sreehari’s Currency Authentication project verifies Indian banknotes by matching their security features. It extracts ORB keypoints from the note image and compares them using the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) to determine authenticity. The system achieves about 94 % detection accuracy.
